Subject: Deployment topology and data segregation — next clarifications

Hi Lydia — thanks again for the time today. Quick recap from our discovery and a couple of follow-ups so we can align the right deployment option (Hosted API vs Dedicated vs Private/VPC):

Summary from call:
- Primary requirement: strict logical and network separation for regulated PII workloads; FinSecure needs controls that prove no co-mingling across tenants.
- Secondary: SOC 2 Type II evidence, key management integration (customer-managed keys), and retention/audit log access for compliance.
- Traffic pattern: bursty daytime trading windows (peak throughput requirement ~1200 tokens/sec), typical L7 latency SLO 200ms p50.

Clarifying questions to determine fit:
1) When you say "no co-mingling", do you mean a) tenant-level logical segmentation on shared hardware (Dedicated pools), b) physically isolated dedicated capacity (single-tenant GPU nodes), or c) full VPC/private deployment on your cloud (customer-hosted control plane)? If you have internal language or an ops checklist, please paste.
2) Is FinSecure's procurement team willing to support an on-prem connector or will all deployments be cloud (we support VPC peering in AWS/GCP/Azure)?
3) Can you share the timeline for compliance review so we can prioritize SOC2 artifacts vs. dedicated capacity sizing?

Attached is a short one-pager that contrasts Dedicated vs Private VPC (redwood-dedicated-vs-private-one-pager.pdf) and an excerpt of our SOC2 coverage. Next steps I propose:
- You confirm which isolation model (answer Q1) and the procurement contact.
- If leaning Dedicated, Marcus can size the pool and send a cost/latency estimate.
- If Private VPC, we'll schedule a network design session with you and our infra lead (Marcus).

Would love your preferences by early next week so we can spin up the right eval environment for your security team.

Thanks,
Neha Kapoor
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
neha_kapoor@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0198

Neha — thanks for the concise recap and materials. A couple of clarifications from our side:

- When we say "no co-mingling" we mean both logical and physical separation for the most sensitive workloads. Our security policy requires an ability to demonstrate that these workloads are isolated from any multi-tenant execution context. That usually pushes us toward either dedicated single-tenant hardware or a private VPC deployment where the control plane and data plane are under our network boundary.
- Procurement: procurement@finsecure.com is the right inbox. Jake (cc'd) will run the pricing/contract review.
- Timeline: compliance review kicks off 6/07 with final decision target 6/28. We need SOC2 artifacts this week if possible; also need to know whether Redwood supports HSM-backed key management or bring-your-own-key in the Private option.

Two quick technical asks before we sync Marcus for sizing:
1) Can Dedicated be deployed into a customer-dedicated tenant (single-tenant GPUs) or is it logically isolated on shared hosts? We need the exact wording for our compliance memo.
2) For Private VPC, do you provide templates for VPC peering/firewall rules and an estimate of network egress patterns? Our infra team will review those templates during the network design session.

Appreciate the help—if you can get SOC2 excerpt and an answer to the two items above by EOD Wed we'll be able to include Redwood in the first compliance tranche.

—Lydia

Lydia — great, thanks for the clarity and timeline. Quick answers inline; attaching the SOC2 excerpt now.

1) Dedicated: our Dedicated offering provides customer-dedicated GPU pools (single-tenant allocation) — nodes will not host other customers' workloads. For compliance language you can use: "Redwood Dedicated: customer-dedicated GPU pool with single-tenant node allocations and logical tenant isolation; hardware is not shared across customers when Dedicated mode is provisioned." I'll ask legal to provide a one-liner cert if you need stronger wording.

2) Private VPC: yes — we provide a VPC deployment that places the control plane and inference data plane inside your VPC (or via peered subnet). We have network templates (CloudFormation / Terraform) and a standard firewall/SG checklist we send to infra. Egress patterns: most traffic is model token ingress/egress and administrative control-plane calls — we'll provide a baseline egress profile (small control-plane telemetry plus model I/O). Marcus, attaching you for the sizing and an egress estimate.

Thanks — jumping in with technical notes for Lydia's team so infra has exactly what to expect. High level:

Dedicated (what we deliver):
- Single-tenant GPU pools: when you choose Dedicated we allocate GPU nodes that are reserved for your account; no other customer's inference jobs run on those nodes.
- Network boundary: control plane remains Redwood-hosted for Dedicated (managed service), but customer data can be kept off shared caches and we provide tenant-scoped KV cache isolation.
- Keys: Dedicated supports integration with customer KMS via envelope encryption. HSM-managed keys can be supported via partner integrations; we'll document that flow.

Private VPC (what we deliver):
- Full VPC deployment: control plane and inference nodes can be deployed to live inside your VPC (or in a private subnet peered to your infra). This gives you complete network-level isolation and allows you to attach your KMS/HSM directly.
- Templates: we'll hand over Terraform modules and a security-runbook that lists required SGs/NACLs, IP ranges, and monitoring endpoints.
- Egress: typical encrypted model traffic to your model endpoints; we will produce a per-1000-token egress bandwidth estimate for your peak windows by Wed.

Risks/considerations:
- Dedicated is faster to spin up (<2 weeks for pilot) and is the lower-cost path with strong logical and node-level isolation. Private VPC gives the strongest auditability/control but requires network work and policy sign-offs (longer lead time).
- If your compliance team requires HSM-backed keys inside your tenancy, Private VPC will be the recommended path. Otherwise Dedicated with KMS envelope encryption often satisfies SOC2 controls.

I will build the Dedicated sizing and Private egress sketch today and drop into the HubSpot deal. Proposed time for network design session: Wed 5/26 11:00 AM PT. Lydia/Jake — does that work?
